title: XOR-additivity of a Boolean function that lifts to a character
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a Boolean-valued function whose $\pm 1$ lift $x \mapsto (-1)^{f(x)}$ coincides with the Walsh character $\chi_S$ for some subset $S \subseteq [n]$. Then for all $x, y \in \{0,1\}^n$,
\[
  (-1)^{f(x \oplus y)} \;=\; (-1)^{f(x) \oplus f(y)},
\]
where $x \oplus y$ denotes the componentwise XOR of $x$ and $y$ and $f(x) \oplus f(y)$ the XOR of the two Boolean outputs.
hypotheses_covered: the ±1 lift of f equals the Walsh character χ_S
